text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper is a scoping review focused on ecological determinants of Lutzomyia spp. sand flies, vectors of Leishmania parasites. It does not focus on land use land cover (LULC) future prediction or modeling. The study addresses ecological factors such as climate, habitat, and host factors affecting sand fly survival and distribution but does not include national-scale spatial LULC prediction, scenario modeling, or mapping of LULC projections. It is not a review of LULC prediction nor a research paper meeting the core inclusion criteria for LULC modeling. Therefore, it fails the inclusion criteria for LULC prediction studies and is excluded.)
